date_note: ZATAZ's page shows only a last-updated time of 20 November 2026; the date of the forum post is not stated, so the publication day is used.
title: Seller claims to offer a US Department of Justice database on a Russian-speaking forum, ZATAZ reports
summary: ZATAZ reports that a seller using the handle "Marx_Elite" offered a database of the justice department and the federal government on a Russian-speaking forum. ZATAZ saw two extracts totalling several hundred entries, with email addresses, phone numbers, job titles and company names. The Department of Justice origin comes only from the seller; ZATAZ says the source organisation is unknown and does not link the sale to the NSA outage.
plain: A seller on a hacker forum says they have a US justice-department database. Only the seller says so, and the origin of the data is unknown.
exec: An unconfirmed seller claim; the extracts seen hold contact details, and the report mentions no official statement.

key_findings: Seller handle Marx_Elite on a Russian-speaking forum; the DoJ attribution is the seller's own.
ZATAZ saw two extracts totalling several hundred entries (emails, phone numbers, job titles, company names).
No DoJ statement is mentioned in the report.

validation.note: Single publisher (ZATAZ, in French) relaying a seller's claim; the page read has no confirmation from the Department of Justice.
